visualReview: Directly inspected all 10 final-candidate screenshots. Authored orange and yellow livery remain vivid, painted panels retain shape, glass shows cabin depth, tyre/rim and light assemblies remain attached and readable. All towing combinations fit completely; no new rendering defect observed. Native 4x AA smooths silhouettes, railings and lamp edges.

memory.basis: 4 samples times colour RGBA16F 8 bytes plus depth/stencil 4 bytes per native pixel. Extra versus previous 1x fallback that allocated no multisample renderbuffers; double intended 2x storage. Actual driver memory overhead is not measured.

limits: Software renderer, DPR 1, fixed controlled inspection poses and manual quality; this is not a real-device FPS benchmark. Adaptive quality behavior remains unchanged in product code.
Inspection cameras remove only render smoke; normal product opening/tour smoke and seam were independently reviewed unchanged.
The map/control labels in controlled inspection are not product camera/UI acceptance evidence; that gate uses the actual UI 14-view harness.
Component UI/opening captures use earlier private composition hashes with the same frozen visual components; final 82-check focus run uses the exact 85adb462 release candidate.
